request.subject: CITY:DINOSAUR:3

layers.text: Change only the colours and the flag: the red hide awnings and the small red tents become tawny ochre hide, colour #b9802f with #7a4d1c shadows, with a few big dark brown spots; the small flag is removed, leaving its bare pole; small bright orange feathers, colour #fe6d00, sit on the tent tips. No red is left. Keep the giant rib-cage, the skull, the huts, the stones, each shape and place, the size, black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
